items.title: Tom Varner interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, August 13, 2025
items.q: that was the one that was with Quincy and Miles at Montreux where they combined forces or the George Gruntz band and the Gil Evans, re-formed Gil Evans band with Gil Goldstein.

ctx.x: Good question. For some years, many years, even if it was a good week I might have had to do day jobs, just like two or three days a week. Sometimes not. Sometimes – occasionally I did some kind of Broadway show things but not a lot. I was not in the world of the people that did Broadway shows all the time. There was a couple. I did Twyla Tharpe on Broadway, which was a wonderful – John Simon, the guy that had written and conducted for The Band, that guy, he was doing the music and that was a great experience,…

– for me, as an extremely low income freelance crazy kid, that provided some income which for me was wonderful. Because we would do a tour – I was trying to think, because I was thinking about Sheila – we did a tour in ’84, in ’83 and ’84, and ’87, and ’88, and maybe one or two more, and then in ’90 or ’91 I did one more that I was invited to, and that was the one that was with Quincy and Miles at Montreux where they combined forces or the George Gruntz band and the Gil Evans, re-formed Gil Evans band with Gil…
I wonder if you ever played with Alvin Queen over there?
